data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1919 opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of $885.053m (31 Dec 2021). During 2022 there was adverse prior year development: gross ultimate claims in respect of 2020 and prior increased by $95.6m, driven primarily by a review and recalibration of IBNR on long-tail classes and by inflationary pressures and adverse development on older years (notably 2017 and prior). On a net basis, however, the Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) completed in December 2022 reduced net ultimate claims by $162.7m. The gross movement represents a strengthening of reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: increased by $95.6m due to strengthening of Syndicate 1919 reserves on long tail classes, following a review of the assumptions underlying IBNR estimates during the year.

Adverse prior year development on longer tail classes (on 2017 and prior underwriting years) and the risk premium associated with the LPT are the material drivers for the underwriting loss during the year.
inflationary pressures leading to the reassessment of longer term reserves and price adequacy.
Direct COVID-19 claims exposure at this stage is estimated to be less than $3.5m net of reinsurance

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding - gross amount) (page 23). Prior year development (gross) explicitly stated in the text (page 49) as +$95.6m (strengthening) - used as primary PYD figure. Net effect of LPT (-$162.7m) is reported separately and is net of reinsurance. Line-of-business specific PYD amounts are not quantified in the report; lob_movements therefore include inferred directions with null amounts except for the quantified net LPT effect. Claims development triangle extracted from the gross 'Gross of Reinsurance' table (page 47) - the report prints rows per underwriting year; these rows were transposed to produce development-period rows. Units in triangle are thousands (report presents $000). Field names include '_gbp_m' but amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD) per instructions.
